measurement.numeric_rule: Take the integer whole days part (floor) of ESA listed elapsed d and h. STS-51L lasted only 73 seconds => zero complete days; STS-135 NASA exact 12d18h28m50s => 12 complete days, overriding rounded ESA 13 days.

answer_scope.entity_scope: All 135 flight designators of the Space Shuttle program, including the launches STS-51L and STS-107, and STS-135. Enterprise free-flight tests excluded.
answer_scope.note: All eligible named source records enumerated; wrong-side and out-of-scoring-window records included.

q5.scoring_policy: Category eligibility checked first; exact boundary 1200, wrong side and too far zero; unit consistently metric.
